lines.1: 「You should have realized I was bathing the moment you entered the washroom!」
lines.2: 「I-I'm exhausted too! And I'm completely used to living alone!」
lines.3: 「You have some nerve getting angry at me to escape responsibility.」
lines.4: 「W-well, don't get so chili-pepper about it.」
lines.6: 「I mean, don't be so hot and prickly. Anyway, bye!」
lines.7: 「Do not try to distract me with such a ridiculous joke.」
lines.9: But after seeing what had happened that afternoon, I knew she was holding back with this kick.
lines.10: What would happen if she ever became truly angry?
